fact: The World Bank appraisal document of 15 June 2021 for the Digital Gabon project says the CNAM-GS social protection beneficiary registry is to be linked to the national ID (NIP/RBPP) and integrated into the interoperability platform, and that the existing registry holds many duplicates.
title: Project Appraisal Document on a Proposed Loan to the Gabonese Republic, Digital Gabon Project (PAD4428)
